title: PIMS MTI Ordinance strike and protest campaign
notes: A contemporaneous The News report published Dec1 describes a two-hour token strike on Monday Nov30 (captured in search output but not separately opened); Nov/Dec reports describe the MTI protest continuing, Jan5/Jan7 articles call it day37/day40, Jan15 calls it 45 days, and a Feb10 Dawn report says employees announced return to work after a 72-day strike. The start is supported by the Nov30 report; endpoint and day-count conventions vary and physical departure is not established. Treat as a continuous cross-month strike/campaign, not as one uninterrupted crowd across every venue; review Jan12/Jan18 off-site gatherings separately. This is a continuation record, not a January-start event.

title: Federal employee pay protest beginning with Jan12 action; separate February recurrence review
notes: The earliest documented physical action in this record is the Jan12 D-Chowk protest, owned by Pakistan 2021-01. Aaj announced daily symbolic actions and a possible March sit-in, but this does not prove daily physical assembly. Feb10–11 sources document separate multivenue actions; a recurrence/issue relationship is possible, but no uninterrupted assembly or exact January end is established. Later reporting does not transfer January ownership to February.
